summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones Sociedad Anónima (IRSA), an Argentine real estate developer, reporting a routine interest payment on its Fixed Rate Series XXIII Notes due 2029. The filing details the third interest installment of USD 1,850,373.96, representing a 7.25% annual nominal interest on USD 51,467,822 principal outstanding, payable on July 23, 2026. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, restructuring, or management change. This is a standard debt service notice, not a special situation.
